# Spotter

> Spotter is a free, open-source macOS menu bar app that watches Dart and Flutter projects and says which dependencies have new releases. Written in Swift. MIT license. Needs macOS 14 or later.

It makes no network calls except to pub.dev, and has no accounts or analytics.

- [Download the latest release](https://github.com/spotter-demo/spotter/releases/latest): notarized DMG, version 1.2.0
- [Source code](https://github.com/spotter-demo/spotter)
- [Privacy](https://spotter-demo.dev/privacy/)
